verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework with a CLI. A buyer could fairly ask whether its tooling supports batch actions across many items, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk operation: `proa ui add button` adds a single component, and project-wide checks like `proa fmt --check` and `--deny warnings` are validation tools, not user-facing bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
